name: catenary-web
description: Catenary web client — first-pass implementation of the design canvas (IDEA-23).

scripts.build: npm run gen:check && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.smoke: npm run gen:check && npm run build:smoke && npm run smoke:live && npm run build:upload && npm run smoke:upload && npm run conformance && npm run outbox
scripts.conformance: vite build --ssr conformance.ts --outDir dist-conformance --logLevel warn && node dist-conformance/conformance.js
scripts.decisions: vite build --ssr decisions.ts --outDir dist-decisions --logLevel warn && node dist-decisions/decisions.js
scripts.validate: vite build --ssr validate.ts --outDir dist-validate --logLevel warn && node dist-validate/validate.js
scripts.readstate: vite build --ssr readstate.ts --outDir dist-readstate --logLevel warn && node dist-readstate/readstate.js
scripts.test:transport: vite build --ssr transport.test.ts --outDir dist-transport-test --logLevel warn && npm run --silent build:rail-new-test && npm run --silent build:account-test && npm run --silent build:conversations-test && npm run --silent build:session-test && npm run --silent build:ensure-self-test && npm run --silent build:no-speech-test && npm run --silent build:image-box-test && npm run --silent build:upload-test && node --test dist-transport-test/transport.test.js dist-account-test/account.test.js dist-conversations-test/conversations.test.js dist-ensure-self-test/ensure-self.test.js dist-no-speech-test/no-speech.test.js dist-upload-test/upload.test.js dist-rail-new-test/rail-new.test.js dist-image-box-test/image-box.test.js && node --test --test-force-exit dist-session-test/session.test.js
scripts.outbox: vite build --ssr outbox.test.ts --outDir dist-outbox --logLevel warn && node --test dist-outbox/outbox.test.js
